about.title: A React starter built with React + Vite
about.content: Build your next React application with Vite, type-safe TanStack Router routing, and TanStack Query for data fetching. This starter includes Better Auth sign-in connected to the Hono API, reusable UI components, and English and Vietnamese localization with Paraglide, so you can focus on building your product.
